picks.title: CZUR Shine800 Pro Portable A4 Document Scanner, 8MP Document Camera
feature_bullets: USB Document Camera: Work with macOS AND Windows XP/7/8/10. Connect to a PC via a USB cable, can shoot videos, project in real time, and open a convenient way to share and communicate. Shine800 as a document camera is suitable for distance learning, online teaching, remote office meetings with Zoom, Google Meet, Skype, etc. It is the choice of teachers and students, as well as business people

Portable Document Scanner: Shine800 Pro can scan documents; forms; bills; certificates, etc. smaller than or equal to A4 size (8.27*11.69 inches). Designed for portability, it is foldable at 90°and weighs 2 lbs

Excellent Performance: Includes a 8MP camera (resolution: 3264*2448) and LED lights with adjustable brightness. Shine800 Pro has a variety of useful features such as OCR, automatic tilt correction, front and back combination, etc. Notice: glossy materials（glossy photo,glossy magzine）are NOT recommended
